title: Brighton College Abu Dhabi celebrates best GCSE results ever
summary: 43% of all grades awarded were Grades 9 – the highest possible grade
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
• 60% of grades awarded the top Grade 9-8
  • 76% of pupils achieved Grades 9–7 across their GCSE subjects.

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates: Brighton College Abu Dhabi is celebrating the best GCSE results ever, with pupils achieving exceptional academic outcomes across the curriculum despite the challenging and unprecedented circumstances surrounding this year's examination series.

The College's most commonly awarded grade was Grade 9, accounting for an exceptional 43% of all grades awarded. Overall, 60% of grades were awarded at Grades 9–8, demonstrating the considerable academic strength of this year's cohort.

Across the cohort, 76% of pupils achieved Grades 9–7 across their GCSE subjects.

Pupils performed particularly strongly across the sciences. Across the three separate sciences of Biology, Chemistry and Physics, an average of 72% of grades awarded were Grade 9, rising to an average of 93% at Grades 9–7.

Strong performance was evident across the breadth of the College's curriculum, with 18 of 24 subjects achieving 75% or more of their grades at Grades 9–6, representing an outstanding level of attainment across three-quarters of the subjects offered.

The results also demonstrate the significant academic progress made by pupils. 97 of 120 pupils achieved positive value-added of at least one grade against their target grade in one or more subjects, highlighting the progress made by pupils throughout their GCSE studies.

This year's achievements are particularly significant following the cancellation of external examinations in the UAE due to the regional conflict and the subsequent implementation of alternative assessment arrangements. Throughout this period, pupils demonstrated considerable resilience and maturity, while College staff worked with exceptional professionalism and attention to detail to ensure the rigour and integrity of the Portfolio of Evidence process.

 Commenting on the results, Barney Durrant, Head Master of Brighton College Abu Dhabi, said: “We are incredibly proud of our pupils and the outstanding GCSE results they have achieved. These results are particularly impressive given the challenges they have faced over the past year, and they are a testament not only to their academic ability but to their resilience, maturity and character. They have adapted to uncertainty with remarkable determination, remained committed to their learning and supported each other throughout. The qualities they have demonstrated will serve them exceptionally well throughout their lives, and we are delighted to celebrate this success with them and their families.”

Nick Crafts, Head of Senior School at Brighton College Abu Dhabi, added: "I am absolutely delighted for our pupils. These are exceptional outcomes, but what makes them particularly impressive is the way in which our young people responded to circumstances that none of them could have anticipated.

Our pupils demonstrated the Curiosity to continue learning and striving for academic excellence, the confidence to respond positively when circumstances changed around them, and the kindness to support one another throughout what was an unusual and, at times, uncertain examination period.

The headline results are remarkable – not least that Grade 9 was our most commonly awarded grade – but I am equally pleased by the progress evident across the cohort. Seeing so many pupils make progress beyond their target grades speaks powerfully to their determination and to the quality of education and support they have received.

I would particularly like to recognise our teaching and support staff. The Portfolio of Evidence process placed considerable additional responsibility upon colleagues, and they responded with enormous professionalism, dedication and attention to detail. Their commitment to ensuring the integrity of the process, while continuing to put the interests of every pupil first, deserves enormous credit.

Our parents and guardians also played an invaluable role. Their unwavering encouragement, patience and trust throughout this period exemplified the strength of the partnership between home and College.

Most importantly, today belongs to our pupils. They should be immensely proud of what they have achieved. We look forward to welcoming many of them into our Sixth Form and watching them continue to grow as curious, confident and kind young people."

Beyond their academic achievements, pupils have continued to contribute significantly to College life through leadership, sport, the performing arts, co-curricular activities and service to their community, reflecting Brighton College Abu Dhabi's commitment to developing accomplished and well-rounded young people.

These outstanding results provide another powerful demonstration of the College's commitment to academic excellence while ensuring that its pupils develop the Curiosity, Confidence and Kindness to flourish at Sixth Form, university and beyond.

About Brighton College Abu Dhabi 

Brighton College Abu Dhabi is rated 'Very Good’ by ADEK and stands as one of the top British-curriculum schools in the Middle East, catering to pupils aged 3 to 18 years old. Operated by Bloom Education, the school consistently delivers exceptional academic results, offers a wide array of co-curricular activities, provides outstanding pastoral care and fosters a strong sense of community at its core.

Recognised as one of the ‘Top 10’ private schools in the Middle East in both 2024 and 2025 Spear’s Schools Index in partnership with Thuso, Brighton College Abu Dhabi is part of the renowned Brighton College family of Schools and serves as the sister school to England’s 'School of the Decade' (The Sunday Times).

Pupils at Brighton College Abu Dhabi experience a vibrant and demanding learning environment, underpinned by a distinct British independent school ethos that mirrors the values and dynamic culture of Abu Dhabi and the United Arab Emirates. 

Situated in a purpose-built campus adjacent to Khalifa Park, the school features state-of-the-art facilities and is staffed by highly experienced and talented academic and support staff, maintaining the exceptional standard of education upheld by other Brighton Colleges worldwide.

Brighton College Abu Dhabi equips its pupils with the skills and knowledge necessary to achieve excellent GCSE and A-Level results, ensuring that its alumni secure placements at leading universities across the globe. The Class of 2025 held over 149 offers from Russell Group Universities and went on to study at universities including Imperial College London, UCL, LSE, King’s College London, and University of Manchester, as well as top US and other global destinations, with several earning scholarships. Collectively, Brighton Colleges are the top-performing school group across the UAE for the second consecutive year, as per Which School Advisor results table 2024 and 2025 A-Levels (A*–A) and GCSE (9–8).

The school's consecutive recognition as the ‘British School of the Year’ by LUXLife Private Education Awards in both 2022 and 2023 underscores its ongoing success.

Bloom Education, a Bloom Holding subsidiary, delivers the highest standards of a British curriculum education in the UAE and is committed to inspiring its pupils to appreciate and value local heritage and cultural diversity.

For more information, please visit: https://www.brightoncollege.ae/

About Bloom Education

Bloom Education supports the development of future generations through partnerships with world-class international education brands, owns brand schools and nurseries, and the operation of UAE Charter Schools. 

A pioneer in the Middle East education sector for more than 15 years, Bloom Education has introduced and operated leading American, English and International Baccalaureate curriculum education brands in the UAE market and has provided exceptional educational experiences and opportunities to more than 20,000 students. The partner of choice for international school brand Brighton College, Bloom Education has been entrusted to deliver and sustain the highest international standards locally and has been selected by Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK) to operate the Abu Dhabi Charter Schools programme.

With a keen focus on providing the best educational opportunities to help craft better futures for the youth of the UAE, Bloom Education launched its first ‘own-brand’ premium IB school, Bloom World Academy, in Dubai in August 2022. The school has introduced many firsts in the UAE, such as Learning Achievement Passports (LAP), individual learning pathways and the later start time of 9am, allowing for students’ learning to be in balance with family life. 

Bloom Education’s opportunity-rich environments allow it to nurture its community of students so they can reach their highest potential – intellectually, physically, socially, and emotionally and their success is reflected in the high quality of their graduates who continue their studies at leading universities around the world, including Ivy League and Russell Group.

For more information, please visit https://www.bloomeducation.com/
